title: The Clock Chime and a Far Dog
youtube_title: The Clock Chime and a Far Dog | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet noticing is a way of being gentle with the world.
summary: At a library aisle with a slice of sun, Opal finds a clock chime arriving at the same time as a far dog's one bark. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Opal shows Dina how to look without disturbing it. Nana Ruth looks too, and they leave it where it is.
